publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)

nominalGeometry.note: Four nominally identical bridge parts are fabricated on each build plate; feature identity is defined by the AMB2022 naming convention.

inProcess.reasonRawDataNotVendored: NIST PDR binary endpoint was not reliably retrievable in the execution environment; canonical source identity is retained instead.

features.name: time above melting temperature
features.definition: Time above the midpoint between solidus and liquidus for the melt pool at specified build locations.

features.name: solid cooling rate
features.definition: Cooling rate immediately following complete solidification below the solidus at specified build locations.

finalCtq.characteristic: ridge release deflection after partial EDM separation from the build plate

pairing.reason: Thermography is associated with P1 while the published deflection specimen is P2; the current project also has no registered mapping from thermography locations to the six P2 CMM ridge measurands.

capabilityBoundary.reason: No production population and specification limits are available; repeated or spatial measurements on one/sister benchmark artifacts are not a process capability distribution.
